messages:
Sofia (CS): Quick pulse on TenantEdge prefetch+aggregation stats for this week. TL;DR: hit rate down, avg batch smaller, cost per 1k tokens up.

Ethan (AE): Oof. Any obvious trigger? onboarding churn or product change?

Sofia (CS): More short requests from the client — avg seq len 120 -> 45. Prefetch warming less effective. Also see a per-request param rollout that reduces batching.

Anika (ML Eng): Can you paste the cohort split and raw numbers? I'll check KV cache TTL and warmup behavior.

Sofia (CS): pasted below from metrics-bot snapshot:
```
cohort: enterprise-tenantedge
this_week: hit=0.28 avg_batch=2.1 cost_1k=$1.85
last_week: hit=0.44 avg_batch=3.2 cost_1k=$1.42
errors: 0.6% latency_p95: 320ms
requests/day: 48k -> 62k (spike)
```

Raj (SE): We flipped `prefetch_ttl=30s` for a canary two days ago. That could explain lower warm cache overlap.

Anika (ML Eng): Yep. Shorter TTL means fewer prefix matches. Recommend bump TTL to 120s for this cohort and enable small-request coalescing.

Ethan (AE): If we change TTL + enable coalescing what's the expected impact on hit and cost?

Anika (ML Eng): Quick sim: hit ~0.38, avg_batch ~2.8, cost_1k ~$1.55. Not full recovery but meaningful savings and better tail latency.

Sofia (CS): Plan: 1) bump TTL -> 120s for enterprise-tenantedge canary 2) enable runtime flag `coalesce_small_reqs=true` 3) monitor 48h. I'll update the customer; call out spend delta if >+15%.

metrics-bot: scheduled: will post updated cohort metrics in ~6h and alert if spend delta > 10% :bell:

Ethan (AE): 👍 I'll prep a short note for the customer with the recommended changes and expected numbers.

Sofia (CS): Adding rollback guardrails: rollback if latency_p95 > 450ms or error rate > 1%.

Raj (SE): I'll put a canary config with automatic rollback lock and add a tracing span to measure prefetch hits.

Sofia (CS): thanks team — check back in 24h for first readout. tagging @anika for visibility and follow-up on the runtime PR.

Anika (ML Eng): on it. will open PR for `coalesce_small_reqs` and set default off for now.

Sofia (CS): closing action items in the thread: TTL bump + coalesce flag + monitor. I'll create the enablement note for CS playbook after we see numbers. :white_check_mark:
